title: Scriptorium Review v1
description: A research-direction synthesis (narrative + comparison table) produced by the synthesize-direction agent task in answer to a question/topic. Outline -> draft -> critique narrative across `sections`, an optional paper-by-paper `comparison_table`, identified `gaps`, and `priority_reads`. Anti-fabrication: the comparison table and citations MUST be grounded in parsed-paper / library-kb, never invented by the model. It may reference a lineage-graph via `lineage_ref` and be materialized as Markdown. Direct Provenance ingestion is a Public Alpha release gap. Additive contract — supersedes nothing. See specs/literature-reading.md §3.

direction.description: The research direction this review synthesizes.

query.description: The question / topic that scoped the synthesis.

created.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time when the review was produced.

sections.description: The narrative body in reading order (outline -> draft -> critique shape).

prose.description: Section prose. Any citation must reference parsed-paper / library-kb, never invented.

comparison_table.description: A paper-by-paper comparison. Rows are papers by citekey; columns are dimensions (method / data / result / ...). Built FROM the parsed files + library-kb, never invented (anti-fabrication).

citekey.description: The paper this row describes (Better BibTeX citekey).

gaps.description: Open questions / gaps the synthesis surfaced in the direction.

priority_reads.description: Citekeys the synthesis recommends reading next.

lineage_ref.description: Path to the lineage-graph file this review's direction maps to (optional cross-link).
